description: Geodetska uprava Republike Slovenije (Surveying and Mapping Authority) publishes the real estate cadastre of Slovenia, the official register of parcels, buildings and parts of buildings that records their position, shape and physical properties, with services for the cadastral parcels and the buildings under INSPIRE. Coverage: the whole of Slovenia; the record was created on the portal in April 2024 and last modified on 2026-08-17. Format and access: WFS, HTML, WMS, downloadable without registration from the Slovenian open data portal (OPSI); the portal also serves the metadata through a public API. Licence (read on the portal page on 2026-09-29): CC BY 4.0, named in the portal's licence terms field (access constraints "none"; data publicly available for re-use); cost: free. Caveats: the portal record names CC BY 4.0 in its licence terms and gives there are no access constraints and that the data are publicly accessible for re-use; the bulk downloads sit on the e-Prostor public geodetic data site, and only the WFS and WMS service links were read here. Simulation uses: national building-stock exposure and parcel geometry for hazard, flood and energy-renovation models, and building footprints for urban-form and digital twin work. Related catalogue records: Slovenia consolidated cadastre of public utility infrastructure (ZK GJI): national GeoPackage and CSV downloads of roads, railways, electricity, gas, heat, water supply, sewers, electronic communications and other networks, updated weekly (data-slovenia-consolidated-public-infrastructure-cadastre-zk-gji); OpenStreetMap (data-openstreetmap).
